name: Shadow
description: Discrete-event network simulator that directly executes real application code as native OS processes. Hybrid emulation/simulation architecture scales to hundreds of thousands of processes for realistic private network experiments.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Shadow with Docker documentation available in wiki (1.2 Shadow with Docker)

eval_notes: Excellent for large-scale what-if network simulations. Runs unmodified real applications (e.g., Tor, Bitcoin) by interposing at syscall API. Deterministic replay enables reproducible experiments - great for evaluating agent decisions under controlled network conditions.
